from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import subprocess, os, re
smi='N#CC#CC1OCC1=O'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=2026)
if status != 0: raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
conf=m.GetConformer()
lines=['! B3LYP def2-SVP TightSCF','%output Print[P_MOs] 1 end','* xyz 0 1']
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); lines.append(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .9f} {p.y: .9f} {p.z: .9f}')
lines.append('*')
open('homo_lumo.inp','w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/orca','homo_lumo.inp'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=240)
open('homo_lumo.out','w').write(r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr)
print('ORCA return code:',r.returncode)
out=r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr
print('SCF convergence:', 'SCF CONVERGED' in out)
sections=re.findall(r'ORBITAL ENERGIES\s*\n-+\s*\n(.*?)(?:\n\s*\n|\n-+)',out,re.S)
if sections:
 rows=[]
 for line in sections[-1].splitlines():
  q=re.match(r'\s*(\d+)\s+([01])\s+([-+]?\d+\.\d+)',line)
  if q: rows.append((int(q.group(1)),int(q.group(2)),float(q.group(3))))
 occ=[x for x in rows if x[1]==1]; virt=[x for x in rows if x[1]==0]
 if occ and virt:
  h=occ[-1][2]; l=virt[0][2]
  print('HOMO Hartree:',h); print('LUMO Hartree:',l); print('Gap Hartree:',l-h)
 else: print('Could not parse occupied/virtual orbital rows:',rows[-5:])
else:
 print('No ORBITAL ENERGIES table found; tail follows:'); print('\n'.join(out.splitlines()[-35:]))
print('Output file:',os.path.abspath('homo_lumo.out'))

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, dft
import numpy as np
smi='N#CC#CC1OCC1=O'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=2026)
if status != 0: raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
c=m.GetConformer()
atoms=[]

 p=c.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); atoms.append((a.GetSymbol(),(p.x,p.y,p.z)))
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms,basis='def2-svp',charge=0,spin=0,verbose=0)
calc=dft.RKS(mol); calc.xc='b3lyp'; calc.conv_tol=1e-9
energy=calc.kernel()
print('SCF converged:',calc.converged,'total energy Ha:',energy)
if calc.converged:
 occ=np.where(calc.mo_occ>0)[0]; virt=np.where(calc.mo_occ==0)[0]
 h=float(calc.mo_energy[occ[-1]]); l=float(calc.mo_energy[virt[0]])
 print('HOMO Ha:',h); print('LUMO Ha:',l); print('Gap Ha:',l-h)
else: print('No reliable orbital gap: SCF failed to converge')
print('Method: B3LYP/def2-SVP, neutral singlet, MMFF94-optimized RDKit conformer, PySCF')
